name: Hội An
headline: Lantern light and slow old-town evenings.
subheadline: A small city made for walking before sunset.
introduction: Hội An is softest at the edges of the day: quiet lanes in the morning, yellow walls in late light, and lantern reflections after dark.
shortDescription: Old-town lanes, yellow walls, riverside evenings, lanterns, and a slower central Vietnam mood.
description: Old-town lanes, yellow walls, riverside evenings, lanterns, and a slower central Vietnam mood.
longDescription: The town can get crowded, so the trick is timing. Walk early, rest through the busiest heat, then return when the light turns warm and the river starts to glow.
overview: A compact heritage town for yellow walls, lantern light, riverside walks, tailoring stops, and soft evening scenes.
weatherNote: Old-town walks are best outside the hottest part of the day. Rain can make evenings atmospheric but slower.
travelTips: Walk early if you want quieter photos.
Stay close enough to return after a midday break.
Treat the lantern scene as atmosphere, not a checklist.
seoTitle: Hội An Photo Notes | Lanterns and Old-Town Evenings
seoDescription: A short editorial photo note from Hội An: yellow walls, lanterns, riverside evenings, old-town walks, food, and central Vietnam light.
